plugins.name: gleaner
plugins.description: Save web pages, passages, answers, and YouTube videos as tagged clips. Get Markdown in ChatGPT or HTML in Claude; save to Drive, Notion, Cowork, Claude Code, or private claude.ai artifacts. ChatGPT supports editable Pages on explicit request when Page tools are available. Shared local-first preferences and optional Drive sync. Reads the Chrome side panel, Claude Code desktop browser, and ChatGPT connected Chrome tabs and Work browser.
